description: Create a new EPIC in the connected project. `projectIds` defaults to the current project when omitted. `state` defaults to the project-configured default state when omitted; pass it only when overriding (must match an existing state in the project config — see epic_list / epic_get). Backend requires `name`, `estimatedEffort`, `plannedStartDate`, `plannedEndDate`. **`description` must be a DETAILED epic write-up as HTML (NOT markdown) derived from the source document (BRD, spec, user request). SQA UI renders this via a Tiptap editor and stores raw HTML — see the description field docstring for the exact allowed tags and required section structure. One-line summaries are not acceptable.** `customFields` may be omitted — an empty object is sent automatically.

customFields.description: Optional. Empty object `{}` sent automatically when omitted.
